subject: Optimizer: Fix null filtering logic for IN list (#53370)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent in planner only. Change replaces local outer-to-inner null-filter check with `util.IsNullRejected` and refactors `pkg/planner/util/null_misc.go` to (a) apply correct AND/OR null-rejection recursion and (b) handle `IN` lists by reducing to OR-of-equalities to avoid misclassification. Logic remains conservative (no false-positive null rejection found) and aligns with SQL 3-valued semantics needed for safe outer->inner join conversion. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: subsequent edits are API/refactor/robustness adjustments (e.g., error-returning `EvaluateExprWithNull`), not a semantic revert/fix of the IN-list null-rejection logic.
